notes: Routing evals for PDM-first fleet management with deliberate native PVE/PBS drill-down. Native Proxmox is not a blanket negative: trigger when the prompt requires choosing or crossing the PDM/native boundary; do not trigger for isolated native-command questions that have no PDM/fleet-routing component.
